text: On June 13, 2016, the City received an application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit a 59-storey tower plus three mechanical storeys (229.4 metres) at 874-878 Yonge Street and 3-11 Scollard Street. In a report to City Council dated August 12, 2016, City Planning recommended refusal of the application (the "Refusal Report"). City Planning concluded in the Refusal Report that the proposed tower is too tall and the site is too small to accommodate the proposal, and that the proposal does not conform to the Official Plan, is inconsistent with Council-approved guidelines and does not fit within the existing and planned context for the Bloor-Yorkville and North Midtown Area.
